items.title: Harold Christophe Interview, 1961-08-01
items.q: If the fellows knew, one was Son Johnson and Eddie Johnson and me.

ctx.x: Who were some of your favorite musicians you liked those days that you would hear? On sax, for instance, was there any particular favorite that you had on either alto or tenor?

Well, I'll tell you, there are a lot of fellows that liked me on the alto. Because one thing about the alto at that particular time, it wasn't too many fellows that could keep the melody. So they only had about three of us that could keep that melody. If the fellows knew, one was Son Johnson and Eddie Johnson and me. We'd known that fellows that could play plenty of melody. You know the leads on all numbers. We'd take years ago, well, the musicians, they always did look up to the trumpet player for the leader.…
Who were your favorite trumpet players? Who did you like to play with? Who were the best ones in the city and all that you heard those days?
